The changes have been implemented, verified across `@tanstack/query-core`, `@tanstack/query-persist-client-core`, and the framework adapters, and committed to the `fix/persister-restore-state` branch.

### Summary of Changes

1. **`createPersisterRestoreResult` Helper (`@tanstack/query-core`)**:
   - Exported [`createPersisterRestoreResult`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-h50locwn/packages/query-core/src/query.ts#L50-L59) and [`PersisterRestoreResult`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-h50locwn/packages/query-core/src/query.ts#L39-L43) from [index.ts](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-h50locwn/packages/query-core/src/index.ts#L58) and updated [`QueryPersister`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-h50locwn/packages/query-core/src/types.ts#L168-L176) to accept restored snapshot results.
   - Updated [`Query.fetch`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-h50locwn/packages/query-core/src/query.ts#L593-L645) to detect `PersisterRestoreResult`, adopt the restored query state (`status`, `error`, `dataUpdateCount`, `dataUpdatedAt`, `errorUpdateCount`, `errorUpdatedAt`, `fetchFailureCount`, `fetchFailureReason`, `fetchMeta`, `isInvalidated`, and `fetchStatus: 'idle'`), preserve infinite query page parameters, and skip normal fetch `onSuccess`/`onSettled` cache callbacks.
   - Updated [`Query.#dispatch`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-h50locwn/packages/query-core/src/query.ts#L696-L702) and [`QueryObserver.createResult`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-h50locwn/packages/query-core/src/queryObserver.ts#L569-L579) so that restored queries and optimistic observer mount calculations preserve persisted `fetchFailureCount` and `fetchFailureReason` when `data !== undefined`.

2. **Single-Query & Bulk Restoration (`@tanstack/query-persist-client-core`)**:
   - Updated [`persisterFn`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-h50locwn/packages/query-persist-client-core/src/createPersister.ts#L214-L273) in [createPersister.ts](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-h50locwn/packages/query-persist-client-core/src/createPersister.ts) to return `createPersisterRestoreResult({ data, state })` when restoring a query from storage.
   - Updated [`restoreQueries`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-h50locwn/packages/query-persist-client-core/src/createPersister.ts#L300-L470) to rebuild queries with their full persisted `QueryState` and reconcile existing in-memory queries by merging data freshness (`dataUpdatedAt`) and error freshness (`errorUpdatedAt`) independently.

3. **Tests**:
   - Added unit and integration tests covering single-query restoration, infinite query pagination state, bulk restoration, and independent data/error freshness reconciliation across [query.test.tsx](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-h50locwn/packages/query-core/src/__tests__/query.test.tsx), [createPersister.test.ts](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-h50locwn/packages/query-persist-client-core/src/__tests__/createPersister.test.ts), and all framework adapters ([react-query](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-h50locwn/packages/react-query/src/__tests__/useQuery.test.tsx), [preact-query](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-h50locwn/packages/preact-query/src/__tests__/useQuery.test.tsx), [solid-query](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-h50locwn/packages/solid-query/src/__tests__/useQuery.test.tsx), [svelte-query](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-h50locwn/packages/svelte-query/tests/createQuery.svelte.test.ts), [vue-query](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-h50locwn/packages/vue-query/src/__tests__/useQuery.test.ts), and [angular-query-experimental](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-h50locwn/packages/angular-query-experimental/src/__tests__/inject-query.test.ts)).
All ESLint checks, type checks, builds, and unit/integration tests across the modified packages have completed with zero errors, and all changes are committed on branch `fix/persister-restore-state`.
